host_processor_frequency: up to 3.39 GHz; limited to 2.0 GHz with the schedutil governor for the timed runs
host_processor_caches: L1i 64 KiB/core, L1d 64 KiB/core, L2 1 MiB/core, L3 114 MiB shared
host_processor_interconnect: single socket per node; NVLink-C2C 900 GB/s to the Hopper GPU
host_storage_type: shared NFS over InfiniBand, served from NVMe RAID on the head node
host_networking: 1x NVIDIA ConnectX-7 (MT4129) InfiniBand NDR200, 200 Gb/s active per node
host_networking_topology: all 14 nodes on one InfiniBand switch
accelerator_frequency: up to 1980 MHz SM clock; Grace+Hopper module power capped at 580 W for these MLPerf runs (590 W for HPL, 600 W for HPL-MxP)
accelerator_on-chip_memories: 50 MB L2; 256 KB register file and 228 KB shared memory per SM
accelerator_interconnect: no GPU-to-GPU link between nodes; InfiniBand NDR200 200 Gb/s per node
accelerator_interconnect_topology: one GPU per node, pure data parallelism; the only cross-node traffic per step is the LoRA adapter gradient all-reduce
cooling: air-cooled; 7x 2U chassis with CMC-controlled fans, held at a fixed 30% duty during the timed runs
hw_notes: Student cluster of 14 single-GPU GH200 nodes. The whole cluster, networking included, is held under the SCC26 10 kW budget: the Grace+Hopper module cap is set per node with the site nv_power tool -- 580 W for these MLPerf runs, 590 W for HPL and 600 W for HPL-MxP -- and the chassis fans to a fixed 30%. No hardware change or reboot between the certified HPL, HPL-MxP and MLPerf runs.
framework: NVIDIA NeMo 2.4.0rc0 / Megatron-Core, PyTorch 2.7.0a0+nv25.04, Transformer Engine 2.2.0
sw_notes: NVIDIA's MLPerf v5.0 llama2_70b_lora implementation with TP=PP=CP=1 and pure data parallelism over 14 GPUs: GBS=14, micro-batch 1, evaluation every 392 samples (CEIL(384/14)*14), LoRA rank 16 on qkv_proj and o_proj, LR 5.5e-4 with a cosine decay whose length the logs record as opt_learning_rate_training_steps = 800. The frozen base weights are stored and computed in FP8 (FP8=True from NVIDIA's own config_common.sh), which is what makes 69 GB of weights fit in 96 GB. Saved activations are offloaded to Grace host memory over NVLink-C2C instead of being recomputed; see source-or-patches/cpu_offload_patch.py. Rank 0 alone writes the MLPerf log, and every run has its own output directory.
